versions.subject: Update powershell_clearing_windows_console_history.yml
versions.detection:
selection1:
    ScriptBlockText|contains:
        - Clear-History
selection2:
    ScriptBlockText|contains:
        - Remove-Item
        - rm
        - ConsoleHost_history.txt
        - (Get-PSReadlineOption).HistorySavePath
selection3:
    ScriptBlockText|contains|all:
        - Set-PSReadlineOption
        - SaveNothing
condition: selection1 or selection2 or selection3
versions.spl: ScriptBlockText="*Clear-History*" OR ScriptBlockText IN ("*Remove-Item*", "*rm*", "*ConsoleHost_history.txt*", "*(Get-PSReadlineOption).HistorySavePath*") OR (ScriptBlockText="*Set-PSReadlineOption*" ScriptBlockText="*SaveNothing*")
